questions.title: Which country will the Trump administration target in its first invocation of Section 338 tariff powers by August 18, 2026?
questions.background: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes U.S. tariffs in response to discriminatory treatment of American commerce.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country whose exports are targeted by the Trump administration's first invocation of Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, announced on or before August 18, 2026. An announced tariff measure counts even if its effective date has not yet arrived. Use official U.S. announcements or contemporaneous reporting confirming the invocation. Resolution Date : 2026-08-18 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-17 update from local Reuters/Al Jazeera/CBS/Korea Times/HT reporting: (1) Canada rises sharply (0.24 -> 0.28) after President Trump threatened on July 17 via Truth Social to add 'incalculable' wildfire-smoke pollution costs to tariffs on Canadian goods and pledged to call PM Mark Carney ahead of their likely July 19 World Cup final meeting; because Canada was excluded from USTR's ~80 March Section 301 probes and Section 122 global tariffs expire July 24 while US-Mexico USMCA talks open the week of July 20, Section 338 stands out as a fast unilateral presidential tool against Canada. (2) Brazil trims (0.09 -> 0.07) after USTR formally imposed 25% Section 301 tariffs on Brazilian imports late July 15 (effective July 22, with broad coffee/beef/aerospace exemptions), confirming Section 301—not Section 338—as Washington's primary vehicle on Brazil, though retained at 0.07 because Brasília convened ministers July 16 to prepare 'tough' Reciprocity Law retaliation targeting US audiovisual royalties and pharmaceutical/seed patents. (3) South Korea rises (0.11 -> 0.13) after Seoul's NSC standing committee held an emergency July 16 meeting with recalled Amb. Kang Kyung-wha over the Coupang dispute (which Kang said is 'persisting longer than expected') ahead of July 24 Section 122 expiry, while lobbying disclosures revealed Coupang spent $250k in Q2 via Trump-linked Ballard Partners targeting the White House and USTR on 'discriminatory' treatment. (4) China nudges down (0.16 -> 0.15) as USTR emphasizes its ~80 active Section 301 probes and Senate Russia-oil tariffs remain legislative; India trims (0.06 -> 0.05) after both US Amb. Sergio Gor and Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal publicly refuted Reuters's stalled-talks report on July 15-17 as 'very constructive.' Leaving 32% tail mass for France, UK, Japan, Mexico, Germany, Vietnam, and others.

questions.title: Who will succeed Oleksandr Syrskii as Ukraine's top military commander?
questions.background: Oleksandr Syrskii leads Ukraine's armed forces during the war against Russia.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by Ukraine's presidency or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera. Resolution Condition : Resolve when Ukraine's president formally appoints a successor to Oleksandr Syrskii as the country's top military commander. Temporary or acting appointments do not count unless confirmed as permanent. Accepted Answer Format : The successor's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-18 breaking update from Financial Times / Ukrainska Pravda and AFP / Straits Times: wartime street protests over Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov's dismissal entered a third day across Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities with protesters explicitly demanding Oleksandr Syrskyi's resignation. Crucially, a senior official in the President's Office told the FT on July 18 that Zelenskyy is gathering top military commanders this weekend (July 18-19) to interview candidates for Commander-in-Chief and is prepared to dismiss Syrskyi if he finds a commander 'capable of ensuring a smooth transfer of power while maintaining a strong defence along the 1,200km front line.' In his July 18 evening address, Zelenskyy confirmed two days of consultations with commanders plus talks with both Syrskyi and Fedorov ('Decisions regarding the army will be developed'), while Fedorov posted on Telegram: 'There is dialogue. I believe everything will work out.' This sharply favors Joint Forces Commander Maj. Gen. Mykhailo Drapatyi (0.40 -> 0.45), who uniquely combines Fedorov's endorsement (per LIGA.net July 17) with senior operational-strategic experience across the 1,200 km front (former Ground Forces & Khortytsia commander) needed for a smooth handover, while remaining capped below 0.50 pending weekend interviews. Conversely, Chief of General Staff Andrii Hnatov drops (0.14 -> 0.10), as Zelenskyy engaging Fedorov in dialogue to defuse protests makes promoting Hnatov—whom Fedorov explicitly sought to oust alongside Syrskyi—much less viable. Holding Pavlo Palisa (0.16, Bankova modernizer bridge), Andrii Biletskyi (0.09, Fedorov-proposed corps commander with narrower front-wide command credentials), and Hennadii Shapovalov (0.07, Ground Forces chief), with 13% residual tail.

questions.title: If Typhoon Noul makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, in which province will it do so?
questions.background: Landfall refers to the cyclone's centre crossing the coastline, rather than areas experiencing its wind or rain.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : China's National Meteorological Centre's official landfall report, including reliable news coverage quoting that report. Resolution : Resolve to the province containing the reported location of Typhoon Noul's mainland China landfall during July 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The province's name.
questions.current_reasoning: 2026-07-15 update: Yesterday's forecast spiked Guangdong (0.29 -> 0.38) and Guangxi (0.04 -> 0.06) on a ~20% chance that the 55 km/h tropical depression located in the vicinity of Guangdong at 3 PM PHT July 14 (moving WNW at 20 km/h) would briefly reach Tropical Storm Noul status before moving inland. With 24+ hours elapsed by July 15 and zero JMA/CMA/PAGASA or regional press reports naming Noul—consistent with PAGASA's July 14 forecast that the system would weaken back into an LPA over mainland China—the immediate Guangdong TD probability drops from ~20% to ~5% (reporting-lag residual). Re-centering ~95% weight onto late-July mainland China landfall climatology under an active Western Pacific subtropical ridge and developing El Nino (with Typhoon Bavi having struck Zhejiang July 11-12) pulls Guangdong back (0.38 -> 0.33) and trims Guangxi (0.06 -> 0.05) while lifting Fujian (0.21 -> 0.25) and Zhejiang (0.19 -> 0.20), holding Hainan at 0.10 and leaving 7% residual for Shandong/Jiangsu/Shanghai/Liaoning.

questions.title: Which Indian state will have the highest reported death toll from monsoon floods and landslides as of August 5, 2026?
questions.background: India's annual monsoon can cause fatal floods and landslides across multiple states.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the Indian state with the highest reported cumulative death toll from monsoon floods and landslides since July 1, 2026, according to official data cited in news reporting Resolution Date : August 5, 2026 Accepted Answer Format : The state's name

local_articles.title: India floods and landslides kill at least 19
local_articles.snippet: SRINAGAR, India - Flash floods and landslides caused by monsoon rains killed at least 19 people in India on July 19, officials and local media said, as authorities mounted rescue operations in affected regions. Eight people were killed in the north-eastern state of Nagaland, next to Myanmar, while 11 others died in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir. “We have recovered four of the eight bodies, and rescue work is ongoing,” Wennyei Konyak, district magistrate of Nagaland’s Mon district, told AFP. At least 15 others were injured, he said. Jammu and Kashmir chief minister Omar Abdullah “expressed profound anguish over the massive flash flood in Rajouri” in the Jammu region of the territory, his office said in a statement. The flood “has caused extensive damage to public and private property, including the bus stand, and disrupted countless lives,” his office added. Indian broadcaster NDT
